items.claim: Souza runs the risk of getting knocked out on the feet.
items.quote: you would agree that on the feet it looks like he could run the risk of getting KO'd, right?

items.claim: Archie Colgan is a Division 1 wrestler who can get his wrestling going against almost anyone except Usman Nurmagomedov.
items.quote: Archie Colgan's a Division 1 wrestler who can get it going against almost anybody who's not named Usman Nurmagomedov.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has lost recent fights against strong pressure grapplers.
items.quote: Lemos has lost back-to-back fights against strong pressure grapplers.

items.claim: Alexa Grasso has the style to trouble 39-year-old Amanda Lemos with takedowns and control.
items.quote: Grasso's grappling here... she's got the style to give Lemos, a 39-year-old Lemos, a lot of trouble with takedowns.

items.claim: Amanda Lemos has only okay takedown defense and never really puts it all together against grapplers.
items.quote: She has okay takedown defense... but she never really puts it all together.
